relationships.name: Placement exclusions
relationships.difference: Google's exclusions are set at account level and stop ads serving on specific pages, sites, mobile apps and videos. Meta's list names publishers by URL and can be applied per ad or through the Brand Safety and Suitability Centre.
relationships.context: Both exclude named inventory, but they cover different surfaces and are set at different levels. Do not treat the lists as portable between platforms.

evidence.source_title: How to use brand suitability features in Performance Max

relationships.name: Placement opt-out
relationships.difference: Pinterest lets advertisers choose which parts of the platform show their ads, such as the home feed or search. That is a choice of surface, not an exclusion of named publishers.
relationships.context: It manages where your brand appears but does not block individual publishers.

evidence.source_title: Brand safety on Pinterest
